names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 19 martie.
Read out of saint.gr's line for 19 Μαρτίου, «Άγιοι Κλαύδιος ο Τριβούνος, Ιλαρία η σύζυγος του και τα παιδιά τους Ιάσων και Μαύρος», with the rank word left off.

death.note: doxologia.ro's life for her: «Când împăratul Numerian (283-284) a aflat de acest lucru, a dat ordin ca toți să fie executați»; she was taken afterwards, at the martyrs' grave. The reign is the interval the page prints; it gives no year of death.

source.text: doxologia.ro, calendarul zilei pentru 19 martie — «Sfânta Muceniță Ilaria»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 19ης Μαρτίου — «Άγιοι Κλαύδιος ο Τριβούνος, Ιλαρία η σύζυγος του και τα παιδιά τους Ιάσων και Μαύρος»

attestations.note: «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 19 Μαρτίου εκάστου έτους.» The page reports two manners of her death and does not choose between them — her prose has her expire while praying at her sons' tomb, and it adds «σύμφωνα με άλλη παράδοση πέθανε με αποκεφαλισμό», according to another tradition she died by beheading, which is also what the couplet over her says: «Ἱλαρία τμηθεῖσα τὴν κάραν ξίφει». The disagreement is the page's own and is recorded rather than resolved.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue as printed by pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (19 September 2026).
